import os, subprocess, numpy as np
from build123d import *
print(os.getcwd(), os.listdir("."))
print(subprocess.run(["bash","-lc","echo $WM_PROJECT_VERSION"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)

# All dimensions in METRES (OpenFOAM reads metres).
R_BARREL = 0.045      # 90 mm OD
H_BARREL = 0.120
R_FIN    = 0.070      # 140 mm OD
T_FIN    = 0.003
GAP      = 0.006
N_FIN    = 12
DUCT     = 0.300      # square duct side
Z_IN     = -0.150     # 150 mm below cylinder base
Z_OUT    = H_BARREL + R_BARREL + 0.300   # 300 mm above top of dome

stack = N_FIN*T_FIN + (N_FIN-1)*GAP
z0 = (H_BARREL - stack)/2
print("fin stack length mm", stack*1000, "first fin z mm", z0*1000, "pitch mm",(T_FIN+GAP)*1000)

barrel = Pos(0,0,H_BARREL/2) * Cylinder(R_BARREL, H_BARREL)
fins = [Pos(0,0,z0 + i*(T_FIN+GAP) + T_FIN/2) * Cylinder(R_FIN, T_FIN) for i in range(N_FIN)]
dome = Pos(0,0,H_BARREL) * (Sphere(R_BARREL) & Box(4*R_BARREL,4*R_BARREL,2*R_BARREL,align=(Align.CENTER,Align.CENTER,Align.MIN)))
cyl = barrel + dome
for f in fins: cyl = cyl + f
print("solid volume cm3", cyl.volume*1e6, "bbox", cyl.bounding_box())

for i,f in enumerate(cyl.faces()):
    bb=f.bounding_box()
    print(i, f.geom_type, round(f.area*1e4,3), "x-extent mm", round((bb.max.X-bb.min.X)*1000,1),
          "z", round(bb.min.Z*1000,1), round(bb.max.Z*1000,1))

import os
os.makedirs("constant/triSurface", exist_ok=True)

def extent_x(f):
    b=f.bounding_box(); return b.max.X-b.min.X

head_f  = [f for f in cyl.faces() if f.geom_type == GeomType.SPHERE]
fin_f   = [f for f in cyl.faces() if f.geom_type != GeomType.SPHERE and extent_x(f) > 0.12]
barrel_f= [f for f in cyl.faces() if f.geom_type != GeomType.SPHERE and extent_x(f) <= 0.12]
print(len(head_f), len(fin_f), len(barrel_f), len(cyl.faces()))

def write_stl(faces, name):
    path = f"constant/triSurface/{name}.stl"
    export_stl(Compound(faces), path, tolerance=5e-5, angular_tolerance=0.2, ascii_format=True)
    txt = open(path).read().splitlines()
    out = [("solid "+name) if l.lstrip().startswith("solid") else
           ("endsolid "+name) if l.lstrip().startswith("endsolid") else l for l in txt]
    open(path,"w").write("\n".join(out)+"\n")
    print(name, "tris", sum(1 for l in out if "facet normal" in l))

for fs,n in [(head_f,"head"),(fin_f,"fins"),(barrel_f,"barrel")]:
    write_stl(fs,n)
